meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 Git 历史：自动识别提交、变基、查询历史等任务，并按照最佳实践执行操作，比如原子提交、规范提交信息、安全变基。
howto.when: 当你要求进行 Git 操作（如提交、变基、查看历史）或询问 Git 历史问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交当前修改，分成两个原子提交。
say.note: Claude 会分析改动并分组提交。
Claude 会用 git blame 找出最后修改者。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个。
say.note: Claude 会执行交互式变基压缩提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Git history: automatically identify tasks like commit, rebase, history query, and execute them with best practices such as atomic commits, proper commit messages, and safe rebasing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Git operations (e.g., commit, rebase, history) or ask a Git history question.

say_en.text: Commit my current changes in two atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze changes and group them.
Claude will use git blame to find the last modifier.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude will perform an interactive rebase to squash.
